disclaimer: Checks are rule-based on provider-entered details. This platform does not certify food safety.

location_missing.message: Pickup location is missing on the map.

location_invalid.message: Pickup coordinates are out of range.

window_inverted.message: Food-ready time must be before the pickup deadline.

deadline_past.message: The pickup deadline is already in the past.

quantity_zero.message: Quantity must be greater than zero.

servings_zero.message: Servings estimate is missing or zero.

cold_chain.message: Non-vegetarian food must be stored chilled, frozen or hot — ambient is unsafe.

hot_no_prep.message: Hot food should declare when it was prepared.

prep_aging.message: Food was prepared more than {min}h ago.

prep_future.message: Prepared time is in the future.

packaging_missing.message: Describe packaging for ambient perishable food.

allergens_undeclared.message: Allergen information has not been declared.

handling_undeclared.message: Handling/storage instructions have not been described.

description_thin.message: Add a short description of the food (at least {min} characters).

address_missing.message: A human-readable pickup address is missing.
